summary: The underlying aiter >2 GiB logits compiler abort reproduces on gfx950, but the recorded SGLang base has no IndexerKPool aiter call path: it directly references an unavailable deep_gemm backend on HIP. No narrow source correction is justified without re-landing broader reverted ROCm KPool support.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual aiter fp8_mqa_logits on gfx950 returned a (23168, 23168) fp32 tensor of 2,147,024,896 bytes.
Actual aiter fp8_mqa_logits on gfx950 aborted in LLVM's iota_range assertion for a 2,149,249,600-byte logits tensor.
The recorded IndexerKPool source has no aiter import or _fp8_mqa_logits wrapper, zero callers of its chunk helper, and two direct deep_gemm.fp8_mqa_logits calls.

gpu_evidence: Single assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, executed both aiter boundary cases; raw logs are retained under reports/j-df16d13326aa/raw.
remaining_limitations: GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable, so the full model and HTTP serving path were not exercised.
The tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify the GLM IndexerKPool architecture and was therefore not used.
No multi-rank or multi-node reproduction was attempted; only the assigned single GPU was used.
The checked-out ROCm KPool path references deep_gemm, which is not installed in the prepared ROCm environment, while the reported aiter wrapper is absent.
